name: fastroute
description: Fast autorouter for KiCad: a Rust port of Freerouting
description_full:
Autoroutes the board with fastroute, a Rust port of the Freerouting autorouter.
No Java needed. Typically 4-5x faster than Freerouting with far less memory; the 'exact' mode reproduces Freerouting's deterministic results bit for bit, the default mode fixes its bugs and routes in parallel.
Design rules from .kicad_dru are carried over: class clearances, per-layer track widths, length and skew rules (length matching with meanders), differential pair gaps (pairs routed side by side). The plugin also routes nets of copper zones, keeps tracks away from copper texts, respects the board's minimum track width and refills zones afterwards.
